mapper.sql: riding_session_id, recommended_route_id, started_at, ended_at, distance_km, avg_speed_kmh, is_completed, visited_poi_count, alert_received_count
mapper.select: INSERT INTO riding_session (user_id, recommended_route_id, started_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recommendedRouteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, NOW()) RETURNING riding_session_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riding_session WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_ride_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.distance_km), 0) AS total_distance_km, ROUND(AVG(s.avg_speed_kmh), 1) AS avg_speed_kmh, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.intensity_level = 'LIGHT') AS light_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.intensity_level = 'MODERATE') AS moderate_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.intensity_level = 'HARD') AS hard_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.intensity_level = 'CHALLENGE') AS challenge_count FROM riding_session s LEFT JOIN recommended_route r ON r.recommended_route_id = s.recommended_route_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riding_session WHERE riding_session_id = #{ridingSessionId})
